title: Customs Tariff Amendment (Incorporation of Proposal and Other Measures) Bill 2017
short_title: Customs Tariff Amendment (Incorporation of Proposal and Other Measures) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill fixes errors in the Customs Tariff Act 1995 and makes other changes to customs duties and classifications.
It corrects the duty rate on certain mosaic tiles, revises tariff subheadings for machining centres, and realigns the classification of paraquat dichloride with international practice.
It also extends a customs duty concession for automotive prototypes to service providers and removes a $12,000 special duty on used vehicles from 1 January 2018.
changes: Corrects the customs duty rate for mosaic tiles under tariff subheading 6907.30.10 from 5% to 'Free'.
Repeals domestic tariff subheadings for machining centres and creates fewer, broader subheadings covering multiple machine operations.
Repeals an additional note and establishes a new tariff subheading for paraquat dichloride to match international classification.
Extends the customs duty exemption for automotive prototypes and components to automotive service providers.
Repeals the $12,000 special customs duty on used and second-hand motor vehicles from 1 January 2018.
summary.affected: Importers of mosaic tiles, machining centres, paraquat dichloride, automotive prototypes and components, and used motor vehicles are affected.

speeches.speaker: Alex Hawke
speeches.brief: The Customs Tariff Amendment (Incorporation of Proposal and Other Measures) Bill 2017 was moved for a second reading. It incorporates Customs Tariff Proposal (No. 1) 2017 to set a 'Free' duty rate for certain mosaic tiles, extends automotive prototype concessions to service providers, removes the $12,000 special customs duty on used vehicles from 1 January 2018, and adjusts classifications for machining centres and paraquat dichloride.

speeches.speaker: Shayne Neumann
speeches.brief: Labor supported the Customs Tariff Amendment Bill 2017, which fixed a Turnbull government error by reducing mosaic tile duties from 5% to free, simplified machining goods classification, realigned paraquat dichloride tariffs with international practice, extended automotive prototype concessions (estimated $13.5 million revenue reduction), and removed the $12,000 duty on used motor vehicles.

speeches.speaker: Alex Hawke
speeches.brief: The speaker announced the Customs Tariff Amendment (Incorporation of Proposal and Other Measures) Bill 2017, which includes a zero customs duty on mosaic tiles under tariff subheading 6907.30.10, extends concessional arrangements for automotive prototypes and components to service providers, removes the $12,000 special duty on used motor vehicles, and simplifies classifications for machining centres and Paraquat dichloride.
